mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was worthwhile because it showed both water recovery and how the lining separates the contents from blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus was straightforward and predictable from the picture, though it helped build the wall.

surprise.text: I did not expect bacteria breaking down fibre to produce gas as well as small fatty acids.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing how the colon wall and resident bacteria have different jobs made me curious about other body systems.
